body.zh-Hant: 據葡萄牙總統府官方網站的生平頁，特奧菲洛·布拉加（Joaquim Teófilo Fernandes Braga）1843年2月24日生於亞速爾群島聖米格爾島的蓬塔德爾加達。為了擺脫繼母的影響，他先在《A Ilha》報的印刷所工作；之後進入科英布拉的學院（Faculdade de Coimbra），原想讀神學，最後改讀法律，並於1868年答辯、取得學位。1872年，他在競爭中取得高等文學課程（Curso Superior de Letras）現代文學講席。
body.en: According to the biography on the Portuguese Presidency's official site, Teófilo Braga (Joaquim Teófilo Fernandes Braga) was born on 24 February 1843 in Ponta Delgada, on the island of São Miguel in the Azores. To escape his stepmother's influence he first worked at the printing shop of the newspaper A Ilha; he then entered the Faculty at Coimbra intending to study theology but chose law instead, and defended his thesis and took the doctoral cap in 1868. In 1872 he competed successfully for the chair of Modern Literatures at the Curso Superior de Letras.

citations.quote: Nasceu a 24 de Fevereiro de 1843, em Ponta Delgada
na ilha de São Miguel, no arquipélago dos Açores
Para se afastar da influência da madrasta
começou por trabalhar na tipografia do jornal A Ilha
ingressa na Faculdade de Coimbra, com a ideia de cursar Teologia
acabando, no entanto, por optar pelo curso de Direito
defendendo tese e tomando capelo, em 1868
Em 1872, concorre a lente da cadeira de Literaturas Modernas
Consegue desta vez assegurar o lugar

body.zh-Hant: 同一生平頁的「政治歷程」列出：布拉加1871年是里斯本賭場民主講座計畫的簽署人之一；1878年10月以聯邦派共和黨人身分參選；1890年是葡萄牙共和黨領導機構（directório）成員；並參與撰寫1891年1月11日的黨綱宣言。1910年1月1日他是該黨政治領導機構的正式成員，並在1910年8月28日的選舉中當選里斯本議員，不久後共和國成立。
body.en: The 'political career' section of the same biography lists the following: in 1871 Braga was one of the signatories of the project of the Democratic Conferences at the Casino Lisbonense; in October 1878 he was a candidate for the federalist republicans; in 1890 he was a member of the directory of the Portuguese Republican Party; and he took part in drafting the party's programme manifesto of 11 January 1891. On 1 January 1910 he was an effective member of the party's political directory, and he was elected deputy for Lisbon in the elections of 28 August 1910, shortly before the Republic was proclaimed.

citations.quote: é um dos subscritores do projecto das Conferências Democráticas do Casino
Candidato às eleições de Outubro de 1878, pelos republicanos federalistas
Membro do directório Republicano Português em 1890
Manifesto Programa do PRP de 11 de Janeiro de 1891
Membro efectivo do directório político, em 1 de Janeiro de 1910
Deputado por Lisboa nas eleições de 28 de Agosto de 1910

body.zh-Hant: 總統府博物館的傳記說，布拉加在1910年10月5日革命當天才得知自己被選為臨時政府首腦；他沒有參與革命籌備，獲選被認為是出於他的思想聲望與共和主義理論家的地位。臨時政府存續到1911年9月3日，其間通過了新的國旗與國歌，制憲議會也開會；1911年8月他簽署了共和國第一部憲法，結束臨時政府主席的任務。這段任期已在名單5442，此處只作背景敘述。
body.en: The Museu da Presidência's biography says that Braga learned only on the day of the revolution, 5 October 1910, that he had been chosen to head the Provisional Government; he had not taken part in preparing the revolution, so the choice is attributed to his intellectual prestige and standing as a theorist of republicanism. The Provisional Government lasted until 3 September 1911, during which the new national symbols (flag and anthem) were adopted and the Constituent Assembly met; in August 1911 he signed the first Constitution of the Portuguese Republic, ending his mission as president of the Provisional Government. The term is already in the list's 5442 records, so this is background only.

citations.quote: Foi no dia da revolução – 5 de outubro de 1910
ficou a saber que o tinham escolhido para chefiar o Governo Provisório
Não participara na preparação da revolução
a escolha terá ficado a dever-se ao seu prestígio intelectual
até 3 de setembro de 1911
foram adotados os novos símbolos nacionais (a bandeira e o hino)
Teófilo Braga assinou a primeira Constituição da República Portuguesa

body.zh-Hant: 總統府官方生平頁記載，布拉加在1915年5月29日的國會聯席會議上當選，得98張贊成票；他是接替辭職的曼努埃爾·德·阿里亞加（Manuel de Arriaga）的過渡總統，任期到同年10月5日，由貝爾納迪諾·馬沙多（Bernardino Machado）接任。同一頁的另一行把任期寫成1915年5月29日至8月4日，與這句不符。這段任期已在名單5442，此處只作背景敘述。
body.en: The Presidency's official biography records that Braga was elected at the Congress session of 29 May 1915 with 98 votes in favour; he was a transitional president following the resignation of Manuel de Arriaga, serving until 5 October of that year, when he was replaced by Bernardino Machado. Another line on the same page gives the term as 29 May to 4 August 1915, which disagrees with this sentence. The term is already in the list's 5442 records, so this is background only.

citations.quote: Foi eleito na sessão do Congresso de 29 de Maio de 1915
obtendo 98 votos a favor
Presidente de transição, face à demissão de Manuel de Arriaga
cumprirá o mandato até ao dia 5 de Outubro do mesmo ano
sendo substituído por Bernardino Machado
entre 29 de Maio de 1915 e 4 de Agosto do mesmo ano

body.zh-Hant: 總統府官方生平頁說，卸任後布拉加在近親相繼去世的孤單中，幾乎全心投入寫作；他於1924年1月28日在自己的工作室去世。國家先賢祠的簡介補充，他的晚年只用於研究，遺骸於1966年移入國家先賢祠。
body.en: The Presidency's official biography says that after his term Braga, alone after the deaths of his closest relatives, devoted himself almost exclusively to writing; he died in his study on 28 January 1924. The National Pantheon's profile adds that his last years were given only to study.

citations.quote: dedicou-se quase em exclusivo à sua actividade de escritor
Faleceu no seu gabinete de trabalho em 28 de Janeiro de 1924
Os últimos anos de vida foram dedicados apenas aos estudos
Foi trasladado para o Panteão Nacional em 1966

body.zh-Hant: 據冰島總統府官方網站的歷任總統頁，阿斯蓋爾·阿斯蓋爾鬆1894年5月13日生於穆拉斯的科拉內斯（Kóranes á Mýrum），1972年9月15日去世。他1912年完成中學學業，並在三年後取得冰島大學神學學位，之後又在哥本哈根大學與烏普薩拉大學進修。德國國家圖書館規範檔另記他「前冰島總統」。
body.en: According to the former-presidents page on the official site of the President of Iceland, Ásgeir Ásgeirsson was born on 13 May 1894 at Kóranes á Mýrum and died on 15 September 1972. He completed his upper secondary education in 1912 and three years later took a degree in theology at the University of Iceland; he later studied further at the University of Copenhagen and the University of Uppsala. The German National Library authority record also describes him as a former president of Iceland.

with a degree in theology three years later

body.zh-Hant: 同一頁列出他的工作經歷，包括主教秘書、國家銀行（Landsbankinn）職員、師範學院講師，以及漁業銀行（Útvegsbanki Íslands）行長；來源沒有給各職務的年份。他在1923年至1952年擔任議員，主要代表進步黨與社會民主黨；來源沒有寫各屆的確切黨籍。
body.en: The same page lists his work experience as bishop's secretary, employee of Landsbankinn bank, instructor at the Teachers' College and director of the bank Útvegsbanki Íslands; it gives no years for these posts. He served in Parliament from 1923 to 1952, primarily representing the Progressive Party and the Social Democratic Party; the page does not state his party in each term.

body.en: The official Icelandic government list of former finance ministers shows two spells for him: 20 August 1931 to 3 June 1932, and 3 June 1932 to 28 July 1934. The list of former prime ministers gives his premiership as 3 June 1932 to 28 July 1934, so from the day he became prime minister he also continued as finance minister. The premiership is already in the list's 5442 records, so it is background only.

heading.en: Origins, army career and early uprisings

body.zh-Hant: 《拉丁美洲歷史與文化百科》（具名作者 Alfonso W. Quiroz）稱，路易斯·桑切斯·塞羅生於1889年的皮烏拉，在1914至1931年間參與三次軍事起事，第一次推翻了比林赫斯特（Guillermo Billinghurst）總統；第二次是1922年在庫斯科反對萊吉亞（Augusto Leguía）的失敗叛亂，他因此入獄，後來獲准在戰爭部任職並赴西班牙進修。國家檔案館期刊的論文補充，他從喬里略斯軍事學校（Escuela Militar de Chorrillos）起步，1922年被送往歐洲。
body.en: The Encyclopedia of Latin American History and Culture (signed by Alfonso W. Quiroz) says Luis Sánchez Cerro was born in Piura in 1889 and took part in three military uprisings between 1914 and 1931. The first ousted President Guillermo Billinghurst; the second, in 1922, was an unsuccessful rebellion against President Augusto Leguía in Cuzco, for which he was imprisoned, though he was later allowed to serve in the Ministry of War and to advance his training in Spain. An article in the National Archives' journal adds that he began at the Escuela Militar de Chorrillos and was sent to Europe in 1922.

Imprisoned for his participation
later was allowed to serve in the Ministry of War
to advance his training in Spain
inició su carrera en la Escuela Militar de Chorrillos
fue enviado a Europa en 1922

body.zh-Hant: Quiroz 稱，中校桑切斯·塞羅在1930年8月領導推翻萊吉亞的政變，軍隊內部的反對則迫使他在1931年3月辭職。國家檔案館論文說，他升任中校後領導了促成阿雷基帕革命的運動，並主持政變後成立的第一屆軍政府（Junta de Gobierno）；離開軍政府後前往歐洲，與秘魯政界與知識界人士取得聯繫。
body.en: Quiroz says that Lieutenant Colonel Sánchez Cerro led the military putsch that ousted Leguía in August 1930, and that opposition within the armed forces forced him to resign in March 1931. The National Archives' article says that after his promotion to lieutenant colonel he led the movement that culminated in the Arequipa Revolution and presided over the first Junta de Gobierno installed after the coup; on leaving the Junta he went to Europe, where he made contacts with Peruvian politicians and intellectuals.

heading.en: The Revolutionary Union and the 1931 election

body.zh-Hant: 國家檔案館論文指出，統一革命黨（Unión Revolucionaria，UR）的前身是1931年1月成立的「革命整頓與鞏固委員會」，桑切斯·塞羅在黨的創立與發展中扮演核心角色，是其第一位領袖。Quiroz 稱他流亡歸國後，在法西斯化的革命聯盟支持下，於1931年10月大選後宣告勝選。這個黨職的起迄日未見於來源，另列為缺漏。
body.en: The National Archives' article says the Revolutionary Union (Unión Revolucionaria, UR) originated in the Committee for Revolutionary Sanitation and Consolidation, created in January 1931, and that Sánchez Cerro played a central role in the party's foundation and development as its first leader. Quiroz writes that, back from exile and backed by the fascist Revolutionary Union, he claimed victory after the general elections of October 1931. The dates of this party post are not given in the sources and are recorded as a gap.

Back from exile and embracing the support of the fascist Revolutionary Union
he claimed victory after the general elections of October 1931

body.zh-Hant: Quiroz 寫道，他以憲政總統身分對反對派阿普拉黨展開嚴厲的政治與軍事鎮壓。國家檔案館論文補充：政府內政部長 José Manuel García Bedoya 提出緊急法，於1932年1月生效；1932年3月總統在教堂外遇襲；1932年7月發生特魯希略的阿普拉黨起義。1933年4月30日，他被阿普拉黨人 Abelardo Mendoza Leiva 在聖貝亞特麗斯賽馬場槍殺。
body.en: Quiroz writes that as constitutional president he unleashed a harsh political and military repression of the opposition Aprista Party. The National Archives' article adds that his Minister of Government, José Manuel García Bedoya, sent an Emergency Law to Congress, which took effect in January 1932; that in March 1932 the president was attacked on leaving a church in Miraflores; and that the Aprista insurrection of Trujillo occurred in July 1932. On 30 April 1933 he was shot at the Santa Beatriz racecourse by the Aprista militant Abelardo Mendoza Leiva.
